text:
Nia Wallace: Quick heads-up for QBR pack: OrbitSys (SI) submitted a late MDF ask for a 3-week engineering burst + co-marketing support to finish our connector. They're asking $27,500 total. Also CloudHarbor (marketplace) wants a runway change to align press and tile launch.
Marcus Li: Break out the $27.5k please (eng vs promo vs credits).
Nia Wallace: Sure — $18k eng hours, $5k test infra credits, $3k webinar + content, $1.5k contingency.
Samir Desai: Finance note: anything >$30k needs Head approval. This stays under but we still need scorecard gating for tier exceptions. What tier is OrbitSys?
Rosa Martinez: OrbitSys is Partner Silver (revenue OK, low joint pipeline). They're promising a GA connector within 6 weeks which would unlock marketplace referrals.
Marcus Li: For CloudHarbor runway — marketing will need the final assets 4 weeks before publish. How long are they asking?
Nia Wallace: CloudHarbor wants to stretch the announcement runway to 7 weeks to align with their regional roadshow. They also request a $6k tile credit for featured placement.
marketing-bot: Policy reminder: "Announcement runway extensions >6 weeks require Marketing approval; MDF exceptions between $20k-$50k require Partnerships + Finance sign-off and a measurable KPI plan." (https://redwood.company/policies/partner-ops)
Samir Desai: Okay — submit a 1-pager with KPIs (expected pipeline $ / MQL targets), rollout timeline, and rollback plan. Finance will review within 48 hours once received.
Rosa Martinez: I can own the marketing checklist. Quick draft schedule:
```
- Wk -7: NDA + high-level outline
- Wk -5: Creative handoff + marketplace tile draft
- Wk -3: Internal QA + legal signoff
- Day 0: Publish blog, marketplace tile, partner webinar
- Wk +2: Handoff to bizdev
```
Rosa Martinez: Also request feature-flag toggle for the tile and pause on paid promotion as rollback controls.
Marcus Li: Add telemetry gates on the connector (error rate <1%, 95th p90 latency SLA) as launch criteria.
Nia Wallace: Will include telemetry and the cost breakout in the 1-pager. Planning to tag Finance + Marketing by EOD.
Samir Desai: If the total for CloudHarbor + OrbitSys crosses $50k combined, escalate to Exec. Ping me if numbers change.
Nia Wallace: Thanks all 44d 4c4 — posting the doc shortly.
Marcus Li: Thanks — will review when posted.
